scope: Post hoc acoustic annotation audit of already-seen real isolated hammers; sealed labels/policy/results remain unchanged

method.original_pcm: Direct signed PCM24 decode, original44.1kHz, no filtering/resampling/gain or DSP imports
method.spectral: Hann-window FFT, local maxima only, log-quadratic interpolation; zero padding improves peak interpolation, not actual time/frequency resolution
method.frequency_search_prior: Author nominal anchor ±1.7semitones per harmonic; candidate harmonic identity is assumed and must be treated as a limitation
method.phase: 16-source-sample shifted complex projection at each spectral peak; independent phase-advance diagnostic within same audio window
method.aggregation: Median/range of partials2..5 no lower than25dB beneath window peak; not a certified F0 oracle
